title: Tanya Jawab Seputar Guru 2019
archive_kind: paraphrase of official indexed reader; original PDF not archived
paraphrase: Teachers and school operators should mark the home-school assignment. When teaching at two administrative base schools, only one school should be designated as home.
interpretation: Supports unique home assignment as the administrative definition; does not equate home assignment to full-time hours or prove non-home attachments are duplicates within a particular city/stage subset.
